description: This file defines a Spring REST controller advice that handles various checkout-related exceptions by mapping them to appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: Spring REST controller advice class that handles exceptions and maps them to HTTP responses for the checkout service.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation exceptions by returning a 400 Bad Request with error details.

methods.name: handleBeanValidation
methods.description: Handles method argument validation failures, returning a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: handleInventoryReservation
methods.description: Handles inventory reservation exceptions, returning a 409 Conflict.

methods.name: handleShippingSelection
methods.description: Handles shipping selection exceptions, returning a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: handleShippingQuote
methods.description: Handles shipping quote failures, returning a 502 Bad Gateway.

methods.name: handleOrchestration
methods.description: Handles orchestration exceptions, returning a 502 Bad Gateway.
